channel.description: Latest articles from For Every Mom (foreverymom.com)

item.title: Couple Hides $1K Cash Inside Baby Products at Target to Help New Parents and Spread Kindness
item.description: A California couple who “struggled to make ends meet” after welcoming their first child is looking to help lift the financial burden and spread kindness among new parents in a sweet and surprising way.

item.title: Billie Eilish Says She Started Watching Porn at 11: ‘It Really Destroyed My Brain’
item.description: Billie Eilish revealed in an interview this week that she started watching pornography at a young age, something she feels “incredibly devastated” about.

item.title: ‘We Have No Visible Finish Line’—The Case for Why Moms Are so Burnt Out
item.description: This is why moms are always so quick to snap. This is why we are so sensitive. Because we are desensitized. We are numb. We are so beyond burnt out.

item.title: Hilariously Inappropriate: Daughter Gives the Wrong Card to Preschool Teacher
item.description: One mom shares her mortifying--and hilarious--experience after her daughter gave the wrong card to her preschool teacher!

item.title: The Actual Reasons Why You Have to Tell Your Kids FIVE TIMES Before They Obey
item.description: Why won't your kids obey the FIRST time you tell them? Well, there's a whole lot of reasons—and they make SO much sense!

item.title: I Have Not Run Out of Time With My Children
item.description: The first 18 years of our children's lives are only the first act of parenting. I have not run out of time with my children. I've gained something better.

item.title: Dear Firstborn: I Wish You Knew
item.description: Dear Firstborn: you can't remember what it was like when it was just you and me at home all day. And I sure wish you knew.

item.title: As a Fat Kid, My Deepest Wounds Came From Words My Mother Said
item.description: If you only read and heed one parenting tip, let it be mine.

item.title: Teaching Kids About the Words ‘I’m Sorry’
item.description: Saying "I'm sorry" won't fix it when we hurt others, but this viral post brings us a lesson from a child that tells us what will.

item.title: Confessions of a Yelling Mom [and What I Did About It]
item.description: There was nothing more heartbreaking than when my son called me out for being a yelling mom. Here's what I did to correct myself.
